titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Philistine King and Samson's Seed (ch. 80)
part: ch. 80 — The Philistine King and Samson's Seed
about: The chronicle turns to the Philistines and traces their kings to Samson's seed. It retells Samson's life from Judges in brief, adds Delilah as the mother of his child and Meksaba as the Philistine queen, and tells how their two sons are raised together until Meksaba's son is made king.

sentences.t: ፹ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ።
sentences.l: 80. Concerning king-of Philistines.
sentences.i: Chapter 80: Concerning the King of the Philistines.
sentences.n: Chapter heading. በእንተ 'concerning' + ንጉሠ, the construct form of ንጉሥ 'king' (the ending -ä is the construct/accusative ending, added before a following genitive; the plain noun is ንጉሥ): 'king-of Philistines'. ኢሎፍሊ is the Geʿez name of the Philistines (the Septuagint's Allophyloi, 'foreigners'). The ፹ is the numeral 80.

sentences.t: ወናሁ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ ሳምሶን ፡ ይነግሡ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ።
sentences.l: And-behold Philistines seed-of Samson they-will-reign over-them.
sentences.i: And behold, the Philistines: the seed of Samson will reign over them.
sentences.n: ወናሁ 'and behold' opens a new topic in the chronicle's list of foreign royal lines. ዘርአ is construct ('seed-of'), ዘርአ ሳምሶን 'the seed of Samson'. The sentence is compressed: ኢሎፍሊ stands first as topic, then the plural verb ይነግሡ 'they will reign' (imperfect, ይ- prefix; plural because ዘርአ is collective) with ላዕሌሆሙ 'over them'. The chapter's claim is that the Philistine kings descend from Samson (Judges 13-16); the son it gives him by Delilah, Menahem, is introduced below and is not found in Judges.

sentences.t: ወሰምሶንሰ ፡ እም፲ወ፪ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ ዳን ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወልደ ፡ አመት ፡ እምያዕቆብ ፤
sentences.l: And-Samson-as-for from-12 sons-of Jacob seed-of Dan he son-of maidservant from-Jacob.
sentences.i: As for Samson, he is of the twelve sons of Jacob, of the seed of Dan, a son of a maidservant by Jacob.
sentences.n: Samson belonged to the tribe of Dan (Judges 13:2), so the text traces him to Dan, son of Jacob by Bilhah, Rachel's maidservant (Genesis 30:4-6): hence ወልደ አመት 'son-of maidservant' (ወልደ is construct, አመት its genitive). The phrase may describe Dan rather than Samson, who is a descendant, not a son: ደቂቀ ያዕቆብ names the line. እም፲ወ፪ is the preposition እም- 'from' joined to ፲ወ፪ '12' (spoken ዐሠርቱ ወክልኤቱ). The enclitic -ሰ on ወሰምሶንሰ marks a change of topic ('as for Samson'). Note the two spellings ሳምሶን and ሰምሶን in this chapter.

sentences.t: ውእቱሰ ፡ ሳምሶን ፡ ናየድዐክሙ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ኮነ ።
sentences.l: He-as-for Samson we-will-inform-you how it-was.
sentences.i: As for Samson, we shall tell you how it came about.
sentences.n: ናየድዐክሙ: ና- is the 1cp imperfect prefix of the ʾa-stem causative አየድዐ 'make known, inform' (root y-d-ʿ, as in ch. 78; ?), with the object suffix -ክሙ 'you (pl.)': 'we shall tell you'. ዘከመ 'how' (ዘ- + ከመ); ኮነ 3ms perfect, 'it was, it came about'. The narrator promises a short retelling of Samson before turning to his seed. The enclitic -ሰ in ውእቱሰ marks the topic ('as for').

sentences.t: አስተርአያ ፡ መልአከ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለእሙ ፡ ለሰምሶን ፡ ወይቤላ ፡ ተዐቀቢ ፡ እምኵሉ ፡ ርኩስ ፡ ወኢትቅረቢ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ምትኪ ፡ እስመ ፡ ዘይትወለድ ፡ እምኔኪ ፡ ናዝራዊ ፡ ቅዱሱ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወይከውን ፡ መድኀኒቶሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ እምእደ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ፡ ወእምዝ ፡ ወለደቶ ፡ ወካዕበ ፡ አስተርአያ ፡ ወይቤላ ፡ ኢታዕርጊ ፡ መላጼ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ርእሱ ፡ ወኢይብላዕ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ ወኢወይነ ፡ ወኢያውስብ ፡ እምባዕድ ፡ ፈጥረት ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ እምዘመዲ ፡ ወቤተ ፡ አቡሁ ።
sentences.l: Appeared-to-her angel-of God to-his-mother, to-Samson's, and-said-to-her: Guard-yourself from-all unclean, and-do-not-approach except to your-husband, for he-who is-born from-you a-Nazirite, his-holy-one to-God, and-he-will-be their-savior, to-Israel, from-hand-of Philistines. And-then she-bore-him; and-again he-appeared-to-her and-said-to-her: Do-not-lay-on a-razor upon his-head, and-let-him-not-eat meat, and-not wine, and-let-him-not-marry from-foreign creation, except from-my-kin(?) and-house-of his-father.
sentences.i: The angel of God appeared to her, to the mother of Samson, and said to her: 'Keep yourself from everything unclean, and do not go near anyone except your husband, for the one born of you will be a Nazirite, God's holy one, and he will be the savior of Israel from the hand of the Philistines.' Then she bore him. And the angel appeared to her again and said to her: 'Do not put a razor to his head. Let him eat no meat and drink no wine, and let him not marry from a foreign people, but only from his own kin (?) and his father's house.'
sentences.n: Retells Judges 13: the angel announces the birth (13:3-5) and the Nazirite vow (no razor, no wine). Two things differ from Judges and are worth noticing: meat is added to the prohibitions, and the bar on a foreign wife is put into the angel's mouth, which sets up his later fault. Grammar: አስተርአያ is the 3ms perfect አስተርአየ 'appeared' with -ኣ 'to her', anticipating the ለ- phrase ለእሙ ለሰምሶን 'to his mother, to Samson's' (ለ- marking the recipient; so also ወይቤላ 'and he said to her'). መልአከ is construct, 'angel-of God'. ኀበ ምትኪ 'to your husband' (ምት 'husband' + 2fs -ኪ); the commands ተዐቀቢ (tä-stem imperative), ኢትቅረቢ and ኢታዕርጊ are feminine singular, addressed to the mother. ዘይትወለድ 'he who is born' (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect of the tä-stem). ናዝራዊ Nazirite (Numbers 6). ቅዱሱ is ቅዱስ 'holy one' with -ሁ 'his', anticipating ለእግዚኣብሔር ('his holy one, God's'); መድኀኒቶሙ 'their savior' anticipates ለእስራኤል in the same way. ኢወይነ is ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + ወይነ 'wine' (accusative), the verb being carried over from ይብላዕ. ፈጥረት 'creation' is used for 'people, race' (?). ዘመዲ is read as ዘመድ 'kin'; its ending -ዲ is not the usual 1st-person -የ, so 'my kin' (the angel speaking of herself) is doubtful, and I give the sense 'his own kin' (?).

sentences.t: ወዘከመ ፡ ወሀቦ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ኀይለ ፡ ሰማዕክሙ ፡ በውስተ ፡ መጽሐፈ ፡ መሳፍንት ።
sentences.l: And-how God gave-him strength, you-have-heard in the-book-of Judges.
sentences.i: How God gave him his strength, you have heard in the Book of Judges.
sentences.n: The narrator points to Judges (መጽሐፈ መሳፍንት, 'book-of judges', construct) as known to the audience, so he does not retell Samson's exploits in full. ሰማዕክሙ is the perfect 'you heard' with -ክሙ suffix; ኀይለ is the accusative of ኀይል 'strength' (the final -ä marks the object). Samson's strength is in Judges 14-16.

sentences.t: ወተዐደወ ፡ ትእዛዘ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወቦአ ፡ ወአውሰበ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አዋልደ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ፡ ቈላፋን ፡ ወበእንተዝ ፡ ተምዕዖ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወመጠዎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እደዊሆሙ ፡ ለሰብአ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ፡ ቈላፋን ፡ ወአዖርዎ ፡ አዕይንቲሁ ፡ ወረሰይዎ ፡ መስተዛውዐ ፡ በው ፡ ስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ንጉሦሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-he-transgressed command-of God and-entered and-married among daughters-of Philistines, the-uncircumcised, and-because-of-this was-angry-with-him God, and-delivered-him into their-hands, to-men-of Philistines the-uncircumcised, and-they-blinded-him his-eyes and-made-him a-player in-house-of their-king;
sentences.i: He broke the command of God, went in, and took a wife from the daughters of the uncircumcised Philistines. Because of this God was angry with him and delivered him into the hands of the uncircumcised Philistines, who blinded his eyes and made him a jester (?) in the house of their king,
sentences.n: Samson's marriage to a Philistine (Judges 14:1-3), his blinding by the Philistines (16:21) and his being made to 'play' for them in the temple of Dagon (16:25). ቈላፋን is the plural of ቈላፍ 'uncircumcised', the usual Geʿez contempt-word for the Philistines. ተምዕዖ is read as the verb ተምዕዐ 'be angry' with -ኦ 'him' ('God was angry with him'), as in the earlier published entry (?); not as a noun 'wrath', which would leave no verb for እግዚኣብሔር beside ወመጠዎ 'and he delivered him'. አዖርዎ is a causative 'they made (him) blind' from ዕዉር, so 'blinded'. መስተዛውዐ I read as 'one who sports/jests' (?), matching Judges 16:25 'make sport'. The packet prints በው ፡ ስተ as two words; it is the single word በውስተ 'in', and the Geʿez is kept as printed. ንጉሦሙ 'their king' (ንጉሥ + ሙ). ለሰብአ ኢሎፍሊ doubles the suffix of እደዊሆሙ ('their hands, (those) of the men of the Philistines').

sentences.t: ወአፍረሰ ፡ መልዕልቶሙ ፡ ወቀተሎሙ ፡ ፸፼ ፡ ወበሕይወቱሰ ፡ ቀተሎሙ ፡ ፸፼ ፡ ወ፪፼ ፡ በኀጺን ፡ ወበእብን ፡ ወበበትር ፡ ወበመንከሰ ፡ አድግ ፤
sentences.l: And-he-tore-down their-upper-part and-killed-them 70 ten-thousands; and-in-his-life-as-for he-killed-them 70 ten-thousands and-2 ten-thousands, with-iron and-with-stone and-with-staff and-with-jawbone-of ass;
sentences.i: and he pulled down the upper part of their house (?) and killed seven hundred thousand of them. And in his lifetime he killed seven hundred and twenty thousand with iron, with stone, with a staff, and with the jawbone of a donkey,
sentences.n: Samson pulls down the temple (Judges 16:29-30) and earlier kills a thousand men with a donkey's jawbone (15:15-16). The numerals are written with ፼ (10,000): ፸፼ = 70 x 10,000 = 700,000, and ፸፼ ወ፪፼ = 700,000 and 20,000 = 720,000, where ወ is 'and' between numerals. Judges gives far smaller figures; the chronicle simply exaggerates. The text states both ፸፼ for the temple and ፸፼ for his lifetime, as printed; the second reads as a total of 720,000 (my reading, ?). መልዕልቶሙ is 'their upper part' (መልዕልት), taken here as the upper floor or roof. The enclitic -ሰ on ወበሕይወቱሰ sets his lifetime against his death. በ- is 'with/by means of' repeated before each instrument. መንከሰ is the construct of መንከስ 'jawbone' (?); አድግ 'ass'.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ብዝኆሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ አንበጣ ፡ እስከ ፡ አኅደጎሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ እምግብርናተ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ።
sentences.l: For their-multitude like locust, until he-released-them, Israel, from-servitude-of Philistines.
sentences.i: for they were as many as locusts, until he freed Israel from the servitude of the Philistines.
sentences.n: Gives the reason for the huge number: the Philistine host was like locusts (compare Judges 6:5 on the Midianites, the same image). እስከ 'until'; አኅደጎሙ is the causative 'he released them' (-ሙ 'them'), ለእስራኤል doubling the object suffix; ግብርናተ is construct ('servitude-of') from ግብርና 'servitude'. Samson judged Israel under Philistine rule (Judges 15:20).

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ ፀንሰት ፡ ደሊላ ፡ እምሳምሶን ፡ ወእንዘ ፡ ፅንስት ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ሞተ ፡ ሳምሶን ፡ ምስለ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ፤
sentences.l: And-then conceived Delilah from-Samson, and-while pregnant she, died Samson with men-of Philistines;
sentences.i: Then Delilah conceived by Samson; and while she was with child, Samson died together with the Philistines.
sentences.n: Delilah (ደሊላ, Judges 16:4) is made the mother of Samson's heir, an addition to the biblical account, in which she betrays him. ፀንሰት is the feminine perfect 'she conceived'; ፅንስት is the adjective 'pregnant'; ወእንዘ ... ይእቲ 'while she' is a circumstantial clause. Samson's death with the Philistines is Judges 16:30. ምስለ 'with'.

sentences.t: ወወለደት ፡ ወልደ ፡ ደሊላ ፡ ወሰመየቶ ፡ ምናሔም ፡ ዘርአ ፡ ኀያል ፡ ብሂል ፨
sentences.l: And-she-bore son-of Delilah and-named-him Menahem, seed-of strong-one, meaning.
sentences.i: She bore a son, Delilah's, and named him Menahem, which means 'seed of a mighty one.'
sentences.n: ምናሔም is the Hebrew name Menahem (2 Kings 15:14); the narrator supplies his own meaning, ዘርአ ኀያል 'seed-of mighty-one' (construct), honouring Samson's strength, not the usual Hebrew sense. ብሂል 'that is to say / meaning' introduces a gloss. ወልደ ደሊላ is read as the construct 'son-of Delilah' as printed (or ወልደ accusative 'a son' with Delilah as postponed subject: 'Delilah bore a son'; the sense is the same). The ፨ at the end of the unit is a section mark.

sentences.t: ወደሊላሰ ፡ እኅታ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ለመክሳባ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ።
sentences.l: And-Delilah-as-for sister-her she, of-Meksaba, wife-of king-of Philistines.
sentences.i: Now Delilah was the sister of Meksaba, the wife of the king of the Philistines.
sentences.n: A new figure: መክሳባ (Meksaba), queen of the Philistines. The text calls the two women 'sisters' (see the unit on their love below, compared to that of mother and child). እኅታ 'her sister' (እኅት + suffix -ሃ); ብእሲተ is construct 'wife-of', then ንጉሠ ኢሎፍሊ 'king-of Philistines' (a second construct). The enclitic -ሰ again marks a shift of subject. Meksaba is a name from this tradition, not from the Bible.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ቀተሎ ፡ ሰምሶን ፡ ለንጉሠ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ቤት ፡ ምስለ ፡ ሕዝቡ ፡ ወለሊሁኒ ፡ ሞተ ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡ ወገብአት ፡ ደሊላ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እኅታ ፡ ንግሥተ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ፡ መክሳባ ፤
sentences.l: And-when killed-him Samson to-king-of Philistines in-house with his-people, and-he-himself-also died with-him, and-returned Delilah to her-sister, queen-of Philistines, Meksaba;
sentences.i: When Samson killed the king of the Philistines in the house together with his people, and died with him, Delilah returned to her sister Meksaba, the queen of the Philistines.
sentences.n: The text assumes that the man killed in the collapsing house (Judges 16:30) was the Philistine king, and names his widow Meksaba. ለንጉሠ: ለ- marks the object, doubling -ኦ 'him' on ቀተሎ. ወለሊሁኒ 'and he himself too' (ለሊሁ 'himself' + the enclitic -ኒ 'also'). ገብአት is the feminine perfect 'she returned'. ሕዝቡ 'his people' (ሕዝብ + ሁ). ንግሥተ is construct 'queen-of'.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ክልኤሆን ፡ ላሕያት ፡ እማንቱ ፡ ወአልቦን ፡ ውሉደ ፡ ወባሕቱ ፡ ፅኑሳት ፡ ህየ ፡ ስድስቱ ፡ አውራኅ ፡ መክሳባ ፡ እምዘ ፡ ፀንሰት ፡ እምኀበ ፡ ቈላሶን ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ፡ ወደሊላ ፡ ፬ ፡ አውራኅ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ እምዘ ፡ ፀንሰት ፡ እምሳምሶን ፡ ወሞቱ ፡ አምታቲሆን ።
sentences.l: For both-of-them barren(?) they, and-none-to-them children, but pregnant there six months Meksaba, since she-conceived from Qolason, king-of Philistines, and-Delilah 4 months they, since she-conceived from Samson, and-died their-husbands.
sentences.i: Both women were barren (?) and had no children, but at that time Meksaba was six months pregnant by Qolason, king of the Philistines, and Delilah four months pregnant by Samson; and their husbands had died.
sentences.n: ላሕያት is read as the feminine plural of ላሕይ 'barren' (?); the sense is unsure, since the next clause ('and they had no children') says the same thing, so another sense of the word (for instance 'fair') may be meant, to be settled against Dillmann. The Philistine king's name ቈላሶን (Qolason) is a name from this tradition, not a biblical name. I read ህየ as 'there / at that time' (?). ፅኑሳት is feminine plural 'pregnant (ones)'. The text writes six as ስድስቱ አውራኅ but Delilah's four months as the numeral ፬ ፡ አውራኅ (spoken አርባዕቱ አውራኅ, አውራኅ being masculine); እሙንቱ 'they (are)' picks up the masculine word አውራኅ 'months'. እምዘ 'since, from the time that'. አምታቲሆን 'their husbands': አምታት is the plural of ምት 'husband' (as in ምትኪ above) with -ሆን '3fp their'.

sentences.t: ወይትፋቀራ ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ ወፍቅሮንሂ ፡ አኮ ፡ ከመ ፡ አኃት ፡ አላ ፡ ከመ ፡ እም ፡ ለሕፃና ፡ ወከመ ፡ ሕፃን ፡ ለእም ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ፍ ፡ ቅሮን ፤
sentences.l: And-they-loved-each-other exceedingly, and-their-love-also not as sisters but as mother to-her-child and-as child to-mother, likewise their-love;
sentences.i: They loved each other greatly, and their love was not that of sisters, but as a mother loves her child and a child its mother: so was their love.
sentences.n: ይትፋቀራ is the reciprocal tä-stem (ተፋቀረ) 'love one another', 3fp imperfect (Geʿez has no dual; the ending marks two women). ፍ ፡ ቅሮን is printed in the packet as two words; it is ፍቅሮን 'their love' (ፍቅር + -ሆን) and is kept as printed. አኮ 'not' negates a noun predicate; ከመ ... አላ ከመ 'not as ... but as'. ሕፃና is ሕፃን 'child' with the 3fs suffix, 'her child' (as in እኅታ 'her sister'), after ለ-. ከማሁ 'likewise' answers ከመ. The enclitic -ሂ in ወፍቅሮንሂ is 'and ... also'.

sentences.t: ወነበራ ፡ ክልኤሆን ፡ ኅቡረ ፡ ወመንግሥትሰ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሃ ፡ ለመክሳባ ፡ እምእለ ፡ ተርፉ ፡ እምቀትለ ፡ ሰምሶን ፡ በውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ንጉሥ ።
sentences.l: And-they-lived both-of-them together, and-kingdom-as-for in her-hand, Meksaba's, among-those who-survived from-slaughter-of Samson in house-of king.
sentences.i: The two lived together, and the kingdom was in the hand of Meksaba, among those who survived the slaughter by Samson in the king's house.
sentences.n: ነበራ is the 3fp perfect of ነበረ 'to sit, dwell' (Geʿez has no dual; two women). ውስተ እዴሃ ለመክሳባ 'in her hand, Meksaba's' is the standard Geʿez way of showing possession by repeating the owner with ለ- (as with ለእሙ ለሰምሶን 'to his mother, to Samson's' above). መንግሥት here is 'kingdom, rule'; the enclitic -ሰ marks the topic. እምእለ ተርፉ 'from among those who survived' (partitive እም-). ቀትለ is construct 'slaying-of'; it names Samson as the slayer. ቤተ ንጉሥ 'house-of king' is a construct chain.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘተርፈ ፡ እምደቂቀ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ፡ ወበእንተዝ ፡ ነግሠት ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እለ ፡ ተርፉ ፡ መክሳባ ፤
sentences.l: For none who-was-left from-sons-of strength-of kingdom-of Philistines; and-therefore she-reigned over those who-survived, Meksaba;
sentences.i: For none was left of the mighty men (?) of the Philistine kingdom; and so Meksaba reigned over the survivors.
sentences.n: Construct chain: ደቂቀ ኀይለ መንግሥተ ኢሎፍሊ, literally 'sons-of strength-of kingdom-of Philistines'. ደቂቀ ኀይል 'sons of strength' is a Semitic idiom for 'men of might, warriors' (compare Hebrew bene hayil), so I read 'the warriors of the Philistine kingdom' (?). ነግሠት is the feminine perfect 'she reigned', a woman ruling in her own right, a theme the chronicle returns to (compare the Queen of Sheba). ዘተርፈ is a relative clause on አልቦ 'there is not'; ተርፉ is the plural perfect 'they survived'.

sentences.t: ወይብልዋ ፡ ነግሀ ፡ ወሰርከ ፡ አልብነ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ዘእንበሌኪ ፡ ካልአ ፡ ወዘእንበለ ፡ ዘወፅአ ፡ እምከርሥኪ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-say-to-her morning and-evening: We-have-not king apart-from-you other, and-apart-from him who came-out from-your-womb;
sentences.i: And they kept saying to her, morning and evening: 'We have no king other than you, or the one who came out of your womb.
sentences.n: ይብልዋ is the imperfect 'they say to her' (here habitual, 'keep saying'). ነግሀ ወሰርከ 'dawn and evening' gives 'constantly'. ዘእንበሌኪ 'apart from you' (ዘእንበለ + -ኪ 2fs), a compound preposition with ዘእንበለ 'without, except'. The speech continues through the next two units; the quotation closes at ዝክርክሙ.

sentences.t: ለእመ ፡ አሠነየ ፡ ለነ ፡ እግዚእነ ፡ ዳጎን ፡ ይከውን ፡ ወልደ ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ከርሥኪ ፡ ዘያነሥኦ ፡ ለአምላክነ ፡ ዳጎን ፡ ወዘይነግሥ ፡ ላዕሌነ ፤
sentences.l: If he-did-well to-us our-lord Dagon, he-will-be son, that-which in your-womb, who-will-raise-him our-god Dagon and-who-will-reign over-us;
sentences.i: If our lord Dagon deals well with us, the child in your womb will be a son, one who will raise up our god Dagon and reign over us;
sentences.n: ዳጎን is Dagon, the chief god of the Philistines (Judges 16:23; 1 Samuel 5), shown here as the people's lord and god (እግዚእነ, አምላክነ). ለእመ አሠነየ 'if he does well/prospers' (አሠነየ, causative 'make good'), with ለነ 'to us'. ይከውን is the imperfect 'it will be' (the jussive would be ይኩን); its subject is ዘውስተ ከርሥኪ 'that which is in your womb' and ወልደ 'a son' is the predicate accusative. ዘያነሥኦ ለአምላክነ means 'who will raise up our god' (አንሥአ, causative 'raise'; -ኦ 'him' doubled by ለአምላክነ), i.e. honour or restore his worship. The sentence can also be read with ለአምላክነ ዳጎን as 'for our god Dagon', i.e. 'who will raise him up for our god Dagon' (?); I keep the reading above.

sentences.t: ወእመሂ ፡ ኮነት ፡ ወለተ ፡ ናነግሣ ፡ ላዕሌነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይኩን ፡ ስምኪ ፡ ወስመ ፡ ቈላሶን ፡ እግዚእነ ፡ ላዕሌነ ፡ ዝክርክሙ ።
sentences.l: And-if she-be daughter, we-will-make-her-king over-us, so-that it-be your-name and-name-of Qolason our-lord over-us your(pl.)-memorial.
sentences.i: And if it is a daughter, we will make her queen over us, so that your name and the name of Qolason, our lord over us, may be your memorial.'
sentences.n: ወእመሂ 'and even if'; ኮነት is the 3fs perfect after እመ ('if she is'), the child being a girl. ናነግሣ is the causative 'we will make her reign' (አነገሠ) with the verbal object suffix -ኣ 'her'. ከመ ይኩን is a purpose clause (jussive). ዝክርክሙ is ዝክር 'memorial' with -ክሙ 'your (pl.)': the plural presumably addresses the queen and the dead king together. The line is condensed and I have smoothed it. Qolason (ቈላሶን) is the dead Philistine king.

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ ወለደት ፡ ተባዕተ ፡ ወተፈሥሑ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ፡ ወገነዩ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ወሐለዩ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብሉ ፡ ዳጎን ፡ ወቤል ፡ አክበርዋ ፡ ወአፍቀርዋ ፡ ለመክሳባ ፡ ወተረክበ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ ቈላሶን ፡ እምኔሃ ፡ ለመክሳባ ፤
sentences.l: And-then she-bore a-male, and-all rejoiced, men-of Philistines, and-did-homage to-her and-sang saying: Dagon and-Bel have-honored her, and-have-loved her, Meksaba, and-was-found the-seed-of Qolason from-her, from-Meksaba;
sentences.i: Then she bore a son, and all the Philistines rejoiced. They paid her homage and sang, saying: 'Dagon and Bel have honored her and loved her, Meksaba, and the seed of Qolason has been found through her.'
sentences.n: ተባዕተ is a male child. ተፈሥሑ is the plural perfect 'they rejoiced'. ገነዩ 'they did homage, served' (?), and ሐለዩ 'they sang, chanted' (?). ቤል is Bel (Baal, Marduk), who is named alongside Dagon as a Philistine deity (Isaiah 46:1; Bel and the Dragon). ተረክበ 'was found' is passive, i.e. 'was preserved'. The sentence ends with ፤ and the next unit contrasts Delilah (ወደሊላኒ 'and Delilah also').

sentences.t: ወደሊላኒ ፡ ወለደት ፡ ወልደ ፡ ወሐፀናሆሙ ፡ በብዙኅ ፡ ክብር ፡ ለደቂቆን ።
sentences.l: And-Delilah-also bore son, and-they-nursed-them with-much honor, to-their-sons.
sentences.i: Delilah too bore a son, and the two women nursed the boys with great honor, each her own son.
sentences.n: ደሊላኒ is Delilah with the enclitic -ኒ 'also'. ወልደ is the accusative 'a son'. ሐፀናሆሙ is the 3fp perfect ሐፀና 'they (the two women) nursed' (ሐፀነ 'embrace, nurse') + -ሆሙ 'them' (masculine, the boys). ለደቂቆን 'to their sons' (ደቂቅ + -ሆን 3fp, contracted; ለ- doubling the object suffix), so each woman has one boy. በብዙኅ ክብር 'with much honor': ክብር is the word of the book's title ('glory'), here 'honor'.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ኮነ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ፭ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ ይበልዑ ፡ ወይትዋነዩ ፡ በቅድሜሆን ፤
sentences.l: And-when it-was to-them 5 years, they-eat and-play before-them;
sentences.i: When the boys were five years old, they would eat and play in front of the women.
sentences.n: ኮነ ሎሙ 'it was to them' is Geʿez for 'they had' (an age): ሎሙ ፭ ዓመተ, 'they had 5 years'. The numeral ፭ is spoken ኀምስ (ḫaməs, without -ቱ, as before feminine ዓመት); ዓመተ is the accusative. ይትዋነዩ I take as 'play, sport' (?). በቅድሜሆን 'before them' (feminine plural suffix), meaning the mothers.

sentences.t: ወገብራ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ዐስቀ ፡ ዘዲባጋት ፡ ወሰዋትለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሐቌያቲሆሙ ፡ ወአዕ ፡ ኑገ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ክሳውዲሆሙ ።
sentences.l: And-they-made for-them girdle of-brocades and-chains upon their-hips, and-necklaces upon their-necks.
sentences.i: The two women made for them a girdle of brocade (?) and chains (?) for their hips, and collars (?) for their necks.
sentences.n: Several words are rare, and I lack Dillmann, so each is uncertain: ዐስቀ (?) 'girdle, band', ዘዲባጋት 'of brocades' (from Persian dībā 'silk brocade', ?), ሰዋትል 'chains' (?), and the printed አዕ ፡ ኑገ (read as one word, አዕኑገ 'collars, necklaces', ?). The word-split is in the packet and is kept as printed. ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'their hips'; ክሳውዲሆሙ 'their necks' (ክሳድ with a plural). ገብራ is the 3fp perfect 'they (the two women) made'.

sentences.t: ወረሰይዎ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ለወልደ ፡ መክሳባ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መንበረ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-they-made-him king, to-son-of Meksaba, in throne-of his-father over Philistines.
sentences.i: They made the son of Meksaba king on his father's throne over the Philistines.
sentences.n: The Philistines make Meksaba's son king (Delilah's son Menahem is not enthroned here). ወረሰይዎ ንጉሠ ለወልደ መክሳባ 'they made him king, the son of Meksaba' (ረሰየ 'to make, set', 3mp + -ኦ, ንጉሠ the predicate, ለ- doubling the suffix). መንበረ is construct 'throne-of', ወልደ መክሳባ 'son-of Meksaba' likewise. The four ፨ close the part.
